note: Web/app surface only: the inline script parses, every id it reaches for is in the markup, the measurement-baseline classifier (the tune gate) passes its own fixtures including a mutation control, and sweep mode's shape is asserted (it snapshots the playing memory before flattening it, writes the snapshot back, and no longer addresses a memory the device ignores - text assertions on the module, plus the parked flat-reference memory still rebuilding from the tune with the EQ zeroed). Nothing live is covered - the DSP writes, the flatten and its restore, the run, the freeze and the mic are verified on the rig (DS18_DSP_protocol.md sec.31, sec.37), and no recipe can stand in for that.
